en: Black-and-white historic view of a brick railway station complex with steep tiled roofs. The main building has large arched windows, a central entrance canopy on the platform side, and the word "HÖGANÄS" on the façade. To the left is a smaller pavilion-like brick building with a hipped roof. In the foreground are railway tracks and a gravel platform; benches are visible near the entrance. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.
